Getting here & park hours

North bank

Head to McClurg Court and North Water Street, then follow the riverfront to the fountain.

Walking directions ↗

From the Riverwalk

Stay on the south bank for the full arc. To reach the fountain, cross at Columbus Drive and walk east.

Park hours

River Esplanade Park: 6 a.m.–11 p.m. Follow posted closures and leave by closing time.
